text:
alex: Anyone heading to the Ridgeway vs Lions matchup Saturday? pub meetup? Low-key proposing a sandwich bet: loser brings a box of bagels for the team :baguette_bread:
maya: I’m in for the pub. Ham-and-cheddar on my end. @owen you down for the bet? :muscle:
owen: Might be. Can I swap bagels for tacos if we lose? :taco: (tempting)
jia: Count me in for watching but not the food politics. What time are we thinking?
alex: Thinking 7pm at The Anchor — can book if we get 6+. Link to reserve: https://theanchor.example/reserve
sam: I prefer 7:30 tbh, traffic’s a nightmare. Quick poll — who’s placing a tiny wager on final score? (no pressure)
sportsbot: Current odds snapshot — Ridgeway 1.9, Lions 2.05. Expected score avg: 23-20. Source: sports-api/v2 (updated 2m ago)
maya: I take Ridgeway 27-20. @alex sandwich bet detail: winner picks between bagels or donuts? :thinking_face:
alex: Loser buys bagels. If it’s a tie, pizza for everyone :pizza: (compromise)
owen: Deal. $5 in the jar? I’ll Venmo the loser to the winner. @sam you good handling money?
sam: I’ll Venmo. Also side bet: best touchdown dance — loser has to post celebratory GIF and buy next round of chips. :grin:
jia: Someone bring a camera/phone for evidence. Best dance prize: honorary meme status on #random for a week. :camera_with_flash: :trophy:
maya: Adding event to calendar now. If anyone wants to ride-share DM me. :car:
alex: Cool — I’ll confirm reservation if we hit 6 ppl. Reactions: :thumbsup: from maya, :pizza: from jia.
(ended with a couple of follow-up DMs about transport)
